Name: De-Creepyd Demetrius
Author: LavenderLight
TagLine: Changes Demetrius' dialogue in Maru's 2 heart event so he doesn't threaten you.
Description:
It's always been super weird and off-putting to me how Demetrius lowkey sort of threatens you in Maru's first heart event. So I made a Content Patcher mod to "fix" it. Now instead of being weird and kind of creepy, he'll just ramble about an embarrassing story from when Maru was a little kid.

In Vanilla, if you choose to tell Maru about this, you get a whooping -100 point relationship change with Demetrius. That's almost half of a heart! So now you only get -10, to match the +10 (unchanged) you would get if you kept it a secret. You also now get a boost with Maru, which didn't happen with either choice before.

How To Use:

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).

2.  [Install Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915).

3.  Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.

4.  Run the game using SMAPI.

5.  That's it!

Sidenote: I changed one word of the dialogue in the screenshot, and was too lazy to get a new pic.
